traits.name: Blood Scent
traits.text: The shark can smell blood in the water from up to 1 mile away.

traits.name: Breach
traits.text: ⬺ (attack, move); The megalodon Swims up to its swim Speed, then Leaps vertically out of the water up to 25 feet high, making a Strike against a creature at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 35 feet of the water's surface or 40 feet with its tail). After the Strike, the shark splashes back down into the water.

traits.name: Savage
traits.text: ⬻ Requirements The megalodon hit with a jaws Strike on its most recent action this turn. Effect The creature the megalodon hit takes 2d12 (2d12) slashing damage.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +22 (reach 10 feet); Damage 2d12+10 (2d12+10) piercing plus Improved Grab

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ tail +22 (agile, reach 15 feet); Damage 2d8+10 (2d8+10) piercing plus Push 15 feet
